channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: House Ethics Committee probes Rep. Jimmy Gomez over misconduct allegations
item.description: The committee cited allegations of "inappropriate sexual contact with a House staffer" in its investigation.

item.title: Actress Hayden Panettiere passes away at 36 after cardiac arrest
item.description: Her representative confirmed the news to ABC News on Sunday. The cause of death for the "Nashville" star has not yet been determined.

item.title: Prosecution rests in Lindsay Clancy trial; defense begins
item.description: The murder trial of Lindsay Clancy continues in Plymouth Superior Court with the fourth week of testimony underway.

item.title: Study: Strong teen-dog bonds help reduce anxiety
item.description: Research on over 500 teens found that close relationships with pet dogs helped ease stress and anxiety.
